+title: 'AgentRegistry: watch, layerUpdates, onReload, AgentReloadReport'
+---
+## What
+Layer 2, reload part (plan.md §4.1, §10).
+
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentRegistry+Reload.swift`:
+  - Rebuild on a `DotfolderWatcher` change when `watch` is true, on each `layerUpdates` value of the marketplace provider, and on `reload()`. A burst gives one final catalog.
+  - `public var onReload: AsyncStream<AgentCatalog>` publishes each new catalog.
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentReloadReport.swift`: agent count, model-visible count, marketplace counts, slash-command names (empty until the command task fills it), diagnostic counts by severity.
+- Look at `../FoundationModelsSkills/Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Registry/SkillsRegistry.swift` for the same wiring.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A `layerUpdates` value gives a new catalog on `onReload`.
+- [ ] Add, change, and remove of a watched file each give a new catalog.
+- [ ] A burst of writes gives one final catalog with the last state.
+- [ ] `AgentReloadReport` counts match the fixture library.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentRegistryReloadTests.swift` (temporary directory and the watcher) and `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentReloadReportTests.swift`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "AgentRegistryReload|AgentReloadReport"`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m381ba0h569xd4wrqsdy3g37
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - SkillsRegistry uses a private ReloadCoordinator (DotfolderWatcher + internal EventBroadcaster + one Task over layerUpdates). It starts the watcher in init. That EventBroadcaster is internal to Skills and to Marketplace, thus this package needs its own broadcaster.
+    - The user rule: init stores inputs only. Thus the registry starts the watcher and takes the layerUpdates stream in the first build (load() or reload()), not in init.
+    - DotfolderWatcher debounces a burst into one onChange. Its init does no I/O; start() opens the sources.
+    - A MarketplaceLayer with isWatchable true (a file:// folder) is watched as a local root. A snapshot layer reloads on layerUpdates only.
+    - Plan: one request stream (bufferingNewest 1) joins the watcher signals and the layerUpdates values. One consumer task calls reload(). A build number makes sure that only a newer build swaps in. Each swap publishes the catalog on onReload. deinit stops the watcher, cancels the tasks, and finishes each onReload stream.
